**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is trying to track their screen time and social media usage.  
[CHANGE] User has been making an effort to cut down on social media lately.  
[EVENT] User took a week-long break from social media in mid-January.  
[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/14 (Tue) 14:30.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Congratulations on taking a week-long break from social media!  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested apps for screen time tracking:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Screen Time (iOS): A built-in feature on iOS devices that provides detailed reports on app usage, screen time, and notifications.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Digital Wellbeing (Android): A Google-developed app that tracks screen time, app usage, and provides features like Wind Down mode and App Timer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Moment (iOS, Android): Tracks screen time, app usage, and provides features like daily limits, app blocking, and phone-free mode.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Freedom (iOS, Android): Blocks distracting apps and websites across all your devices, helping you stay focused and reduce screen time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. StayFocused (Chrome extension): Blocks distracting websites and limits your access to them, helping you stay productive.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested tools for social media tracking and management:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. RescueTime (Web, iOS, Android): Tracks how you spend your time on your computer or mobile device, providing insights into your productivity and social media usage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Hootsuite Insights (Web): A social media analytics tool that provides insights into your social media usage, including time spent on each platform.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Cold Turkey (Web, iOS, Android): Blocks social media and other distracting websites, helping you stay focused and avoid mindless scrolling.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. SelfControl (Mac): A free, open-source app that blocks distracting websites and emails for a set period, helping you stay productive.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. StayAway (iOS): Tracks your social media usage and provides features like app blocking, screen time tracking, and goal setting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested other tools:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Website blockers: Tools like uBlock Origin, AdBlock, and News Feed Eradicator can help you avoid distracting websites and reduce your social media usage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Browser extensions
